narrative:
Material PL3__M36D6800 exhibits a erratic demand pattern with clear ramp-up from low initial demand 
to stable production levels (~3000 units/day). The demand became stable around observation 50, with CV=0.96. 
Lead time is variable (CV=0.70). The optimized policy recommends a safety stock of 4467 units 
and order quantity of 28317 units (constrained by storage capacity), yielding a 85.3% cost reduction 
compared to the SAP baseline. The 95% service level target requires significant buffer 
due to demand variability and lead time uncertainty.
warnings: Variable lead time (CV=0.70) increases supply chain risk

research_insights.selected_model: Economic Order Quantity (EOQ) with safety stock
research_insights.selection_rationale:
EOQ model selected due to erratic demand regime after ramp-up phase. 
Normal approximation used for LTD calculations given sufficient data points (n=141). 
Storage capacity constraint limits order quantity below unconstrained EOQ.
research_insights.boundary_risk:
Storage capacity is at 100.0% utilization. 
Any demand increase or extended lead times could breach storage limits. Lead time variability (CV=0.70) 
poses moderate risk to service level.
